purpose: E open item: reproduce the slower Commercial System A non-indexed scans after an indexed workload on the same instance (E order) versus a fresh restart (A order)

steps.command: source <campaign>/code/rc_env.sh commercial_a && cd $RC_CAMPAIGN && taskset -c 2,3 $RC_PY code/rc_commercial_a_probe.py --campaign-dir $RC_CAMPAIGN --label fresh-restart-non-indexed --queries 6 17 20 21 --repeat 3 --out evidence/commercial_a-repro/1-fresh-restart-non-indexed.json

source <campaign>/code/rc_env.sh commercial_a && cd $RC_CAMPAIGN && taskset -c 2,3 $RC_PY code/rc_commercial_a_probe.py --campaign-dir $RC_CAMPAIGN --label indexed-workload --queries 6 17 18 20 21 --repeat 3 --workload --out evidence/commercial_a-repro/2-indexed-workload.json

source <campaign>/code/rc_env.sh commercial_a && cd $RC_CAMPAIGN && taskset -c 2,3 $RC_PY code/rc_commercial_a_probe.py --campaign-dir $RC_CAMPAIGN --label after-indexed-workload-non-indexed --queries 6 17 20 21 --repeat 3 --out evidence/commercial_a-repro/3-after-indexed-workload-non-indexed.json
